### Summary

Only the condensation reactions listed with `type: nucleation` in the YAML input take part in saturation adjustment.
Each carries the formula of its saturation constant and an optional temperature range. The entry point is
`NucleationOptionsImpl::from_yaml`
({{< code src/thermo/nucleation.cpp NucleationOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}).
